snippet.title: Delivery Issues - Steam Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam and play at SAGE 2025! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2318580/Delivery_Issues/ 

Delivery Issues is a side-scrolling package-throwing time-attack action-platformer that tests your package delivery skills against a zany world of characters and events that just happen to make an easy job... difficult.

You are Evangeline, Eve for short, and you’ve recently started working at WINGS, the family delivery business. The family’s legacy is on your shoulders as competition abounds; it takes all your skill, speed, and expertise in order to keep the money rolling into the coffers. You live in a zany world where technology is just beginning to make life easier for all.

Trailer by Jessica M. Jacuinde
